category.description: Short singular object category, or 'unknown' if dropped.

supercategory.description: One of: heavy equipment, temporary works, container, vehicle, structure, material, PPE, tool, fixture, signage, vegetation, safety equipment, other, unknown.

attributes.description: Visible attributes only: color, material, shape, condition, markings.

description.description: One short phrase describing the target object. Empty string if dropped.

decision.description: Whether this detection is usable for object captioning and site search.
